comments.author: Visitor
comments.body: I saw this listed on the Florentine page beside Tyrian purple and Turkish carpet, both of which I have found to be excellent for handicrafts and sewing contribution points, respectively. Does that mean Damascus swords are the best option for casting points?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: These give around 14-17 casting contribution points. Can't say for sure if they're the best possible option, but Cannon give around 12-13 points. Of course, it's a lot easier to load up on cannons than it is Damascus Swords, too. (Thanks to my casting buddy for the helping with comparison.)
